title: Flat convergence iff weak convergence (Simon 7.2)
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and integer multiplicity T, T_j ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U: T_j ⇀ T in U if and only if flatDistance W (T_j) T → 0 for every open W ⊂⊂ U, where d_W(X,Y) = inf{M_W(S) + M_W(R) : X − Y = ∂R + S, R ∈ D_{m+2}(U), S ∈ D_{m+1}(U) integer multiplicity}.
